design: D1 An overturn is an ordinary evidence_reviews row; no schema change. D2 One rule for both planes: a decided piece is the operator's to reverse, with a reason.

checked: Acceptance tests written first (xfail strict) through the real routes on both planes, then built

problem: The evidence list offered Accept/Reject only while a piece was awaiting, so the operator had no screen to reverse a decision, while a granted agent could overturn any decision silently: the 2026-10-18 sweep's tester accepted a piece its own review had rejected, recorded against an earlier wording, and got review_state accepted back with no note and no stale-digest refusal.

requirements.rationale: Operator decision 2026-10-18: a decision another reviewer took is not an agent's to reverse, and accepting evidence for an earlier wording verifies nothing the requirement says today. An agent deciding a decided piece is refused 409 already_decided naming its decision; accepting stale evidence is refused 409 evidence_stale for every actor; rejecting stale evidence stays allowed.
requirements.statement: An agent SHALL decide only awaiting evidence; only the operator SHALL overturn a decided piece, with a reason; evidence whose digest is not its requirement's current digest SHALL NOT be accepted.

requirements.rationale: F672's 'rejecting an accepted piece reopens the task' worked by API only; the reversal is a review row, so the history shows it by sequence with no schema change.
requirements.statement: The operator SHALL overturn a decided piece through POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/project/spec/evidence/{evidence_id}/overturn with a non-empty reason, and through the Overturn control on a decided piece in the evidence list. The overturn SHALL record the opposite decision as a new review carrying the reason, SHALL answer the evidence view with overturned.from naming the previous decision, and SHALL have the consequences a first decision has: accepting integrates what waited on it, and rejecting a piece of an approved task reopens it. A missing reason SHALL be refused 422 overturn_needs_reason and an awaiting piece 409 not_decided. On the operator's plain decision route, the same decision again on a decided piece SHALL be refused 409 already_decided, and the opposite one SHALL need a reason (422 overturn_needs_reason).

in_scope: The Overturn control in the evidence list
non_goals: decide_with_verdict (a reviewer's verdict) still accepts a task's awaiting stale-digest piece; coverage counts only current-digest acceptance (backlog)

summary: Agents decide awaiting evidence only; the operator overturns a decided piece with a required reason through a route and an Overturn control; evidence recorded for an earlier wording is never accepted (F692).
title: A decided piece of evidence is overturned only by the operator, with a reason
